canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted object keys, compact separators

persistenceConfirmation.firstSignal: valid unchanged breakout/trend signal at previous close t creates pending confirmation only; no entry at next open
persistenceConfirmation.confirmation: same symbol must satisfy the same unchanged breakout/trend signal on immediately following trading-session close t+1
persistenceConfirmation.entry: enter at open t+2 only after confirmation at t+1; use strength and volScale computed at confirming close t+1
persistenceConfirmation.failure: if t+1 is not a valid signal, pending confirmation expires with no entry; no grace period
persistenceConfirmation.hold: 12 sessions inclusive from actual entry session; exitIndex = entryIndex + hold - 1
persistenceConfirmation.foldBoundary: no entry unless confirming close and following entry open are both inside the fold; existing positions still liquidate at fold end

method.entry: candidate only: two consecutive valid previous-close signals; entry on open after second signal; CONTROL uses original one-signal next-open entry
method.exit: 12th session close inclusive of actual entry; liquidate at fold end
method.control: CONTROL diagnostic only; PERSISTENCE_CONFIRMATION candidate eligible
